messages.subject: package installation failure
parts:
Hello -

I'm trying to create an app with the RJSDMX package from https://github.com/amattioc/SDMX/

the package installs with devtools::install_github("amattioc/sdmx", subdir="RJSDMX")

The manifest.json entry looks okay as it locates the subdir properly

The script below creates an application folder with ui.R and server.R and initializes deployment on shinyapps.io

The authentication in setAccountInfo() needs to be changed

Any advice highly appreciated



## create test application
folder.test <- file.path("~/Downloads", "sdmxBrowserTest")
dir.create(path = folder.test)

files <- list(ui = "library(shiny)",
              server = "library(shiny) library(RJSDMX)")

for (f in seq(along = files)) {
  file <- file.path(folder, paste0(names(files)[f], ".R"))
  filecon <- file(file)
  writeLines(text = files[[f]], con = filecon)
  close(filecon)
}

devtools::install_github("rstudio/shinyapps")

shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name=accountname,
               token=token,

shinyapps::deployApp(appDir = folder.test)
